description: Compare package prices per equal mass, volume or whole item count in one entered currency, with exact tie detection and compatible units only. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

currency.description: Entered three-letter currency label (letters only), shared by all prices; no exchange rates.

price.description: Nonnegative price in the one entered currency. Enter a bounded decimal or fraction string; positive except openings/price.

quantity.description: Positive net package quantity; whole numbers for item count. Enter a bounded decimal or fraction string; positive except openings/price.

unit.description: Explicit package unit; all packages must match target dimension.

targetUnit.description: One common mass, volume or count unit for comparison.

name: unit_price

outputSchema.description: Structured entered quantities, explicit unit labels, calculated results and formula; per-package price per target unit and zero-based indexes of every exact minimum.

title: Unit Price Calculator
